description: This PHP source file is a controller class for administrative management of geographic zones within an OpenCart-based e-commerce platform. It handles actions such as listing, creating, editing, enabling/disabling, and deleting zones with various filters and permissions.

classes.name: Zone
classes.description: Controller class managing administrative functions for geographical zones in the OpenCart system, including CRUD operations and filtering.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point to display the zone list interface.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX requests to return the list of zones.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML view for listing zones, including filters, sorting, pagination, and links.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a zone, pre-populating data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes POST data to create or update a zone, with permission and validation checks.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected zones after validation and dependency checks.
